tools.name: context
tools.description: What a file is in the app: the page or module, the endpoints it serves and calls, tables, the owning spec change, open tasks, and the tests to run, in a few hundred tokens. Worth it when you would otherwise open the files around it; not needed for an edit inside one file.

depth.description: code: a short window at each anchor (opt-in)

tools.name: impact
tools.description: Before renaming, moving or removing a route, procedure or API call: every page, client call, module, table, test and requirement that reaches it, in one list, so you do not grep for each caller. Also names endpoints no test covers.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find where something lives when the task describes it instead of naming a file: plain words ("inbox count", "favorite an article") or a URL. Matches endpoints, pages, modules, tables, requirements and tests, one line per hit, including URLs that exist only once a router prefix and a route are joined, which grep cannot find. With text: true, scan source lines for a literal string (or a regex) instead.

text.description: search source lines instead of graph names

regex.description: treat query as a regular expression (text search only)

tools.name: changed
tools.description: What the graph gained or lost since a git ref (default HEAD) or a saved graph.json: endpoints, pages, tables, modules, requirements. A removed endpoint still called by the base is named with its caller count.

from.description: path to a saved graph.json, relative to the repo

all.description: show up to 60 per section instead of 12

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Run the gate on the current diff: broken calls, untested endpoints, the owning change, and the exact commands to run the tests. Call it before saying done.

files.description: repo-relative paths; default: the git diff

strict.description: an untested endpoint fails the gate
